confirmation.method: Actual production engine. 20->30, paired independent event/action RNG, fixed ratio per shuffled ten-action block. Default stats 60/20/10, first event option. Counterfactuals restore every config. State-aware choices maximize efficiency minus 40 for danger or 15 for warning; ties use first option. Held-out seeds add 10000. Direct-stat benefit counts detect a nonzero immediate clamped delta in the action phase for four stat passives; they exclude later event effects, EXP and event-amplifier passives (null).
